source.title: Appointment of New WMT Leader (July 2018)
source.content:
The successful passing of the recent amendments to the Motions has established the WCA Marketing Team that is in need of a leader. **The WCA Marketing Team (WMT)** is an Advisory Committee of the WCA which is responsible for developing and managing the WCA Brand, seeking sponsorships, supporting the distribution of WCA Competition Gear, and marketing WCA Merchandise.
<!--break-->
Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 6 hours per week on average to work for the Team. The qualities expected of candidates are:
      1. Marketing background
      2. Social media knowledge
      3. Fluent English
      4. Communication skills

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until **July 31st, 2018, 23:59 UTC** privately to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:
      - Brief personal introduction.
      - Summary of activities done for the WCA.
      - Ambitions as the WMT Leader.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WMT are copied from [WCA Motion 10.2018.1](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_Cnyl6b248_qgFDPtklWCPpxDjfmCMQ7/view).

The week after the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2017.0](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NDLzup8rbfw8En0S6vtChNti9IKopDBq/edit).

Thank you in advance for your candidacies and support!

translation.title: 招募 WCA 市场营销组新负责人（2018 年 7 月）
translation.content:
近期议案修订获通过后，WCA 市场营销组正式成立，目前需要一位负责人。**WCA 市场营销组（WMT）**是 WCA 的咨询委员会之一，负责发展和管理 WCA 品牌、争取赞助、协助分发 WCA 比赛器材，以及推广 WCA 周边商品。

候选人应完成整个任期（24 个月），平均每周至少投入 6 小时处理团队工作。我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

1. 市场营销背景。
2. 了解社交媒体。
3. 英语流利。
4. 良好的沟通能力。

申请截止时间为 **2018 年 7 月 31 日 23:59 UTC**。请将申请材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

- 简短的个人介绍。
- 曾为 WCA 开展的工作概述。
- 担任 WMT 负责人后的工作设想。

此外，请提交一份可在申请期结束后公开的申请材料副本。

WMT 的权利与职责依据 [WCA 议案 10.2018.1](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_Cnyl6b248_qgFDPtklWCPpxDjfmCMQ7/view)。

申请期结束后的下一周，WCA 董事会将投票选出人选，再由高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认，随后公布新负责人。流程详见 [WCA 议案 10.2017.0](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NDLzup8rbfw8En0S6vtChNti9IKopDBq/edit)第 4 节。

提前感谢大家的申请与支持！
